entities.summary: Stanisław Golski (Gulski) of the Rola coat of arms was a Ruthenian Voivode from 1603, Podolia from 1599, Castellan of Halych from 1594, Starosta of Bar and Letychiv, diplomatic representative of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth in the Ottoman Empire in 1597.
